text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I wanted to talk to you about the Satsuki Sho. I don't think I'm ready to run in it just yet.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I just don't feel adequate enough to nail the race when things come down to the wire… So, please, can I just watch this as a spectator?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Kitasan Black looks extremely frustrated as she makes her request through gritted teeth. She must be truly agonized by this situation.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In the end, we decide to pass up the Satsuki Sho and just observe it this time. However…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We witness something incredible at the end of the race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Patter, patter, patter, patter!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Aaand they're through the last turn! What's this? Brusquement has been forced all the way to the outside!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: She hurriedly tries to make it back on the inside, but can she still make up the lost distance?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ohhh?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Uh-oh! Things aren't looking great for her!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Brusquement! She should be picking up speed during this critical moment, but—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her momentum is disrupted, and she's forced to slow down. There's no way she can rally back after that…

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Ngh! She's ever the wild runner. The race would be over for any other run-of-the-mill Umamusume, but…

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Show us what you're made of, Brusquement. Show us your refined, potent ability to clear any obstacle.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: But look! Brusquement is closing in fiercely from the outside as if nothing ever happened! And—

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: She outruns all the others in one fell swoop! She's passed the finish line in first plaaace! What power! What sheer strength and speed!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Trainer… What was that? What was with that final burst of speed?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That was incredible. No one should be able to pull that off, but Brusquement made it look easy…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Brusquement's fast, but the speed at which you started celebrating was incredible too, Air Groove! Both of you were on mega-Bakushin levels!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I was wondering why you were pumping your fists in triumph when the race was so far from being done!
choice_data_list: …?! Could it be you knew from the beginning?
…?! Could it be you knew from the beginning?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Trainer? What are you talking about?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Even after that huge blunder Brusquement made in the middle of the race, Air Groove never had any doubts…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She had full confidence that Brusquement was going to win.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After the race, Air Groove is swarmed by reporters hoping to interview her.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: That was quite a dramatic win Brusquement had today, Air Groove! It's unbelievable she was able to take back the lead from that position!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: Will Brusquement be heading straight into the Derby next? Or will she run another race first?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: That is her trainer's decision to make. However, if you wish for my opinion as her advisor…

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I believe there's no issue if she runs in the Derby next. Tokyo's long straightaways will be no match for the acceleration she displayed today.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: So many eyes are on Brusquement… I can't really blame people for being invested in her after that race, but still…

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I can't believe how starkly different we are when it comes to seizing decisive moments… Ngh… I don't stack up to her at all yet…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Chin up! Don't let this eat at you! The Classic Triple Crown's barely even started!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Bakushin O…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: This is no time to turn your eyes away from the finish line! Keep your head up and keep heading toward tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: BAKUSHIN! BAKUSHIIIN!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Right! Bakushin, Bakushiiin!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sakura Bakushin O's pep talk pulls Kitasan Black out from the dumps. I hope today's shock won't keep her from moving forward and improving.
